import { useState } from 'react' import { Container, Row, Col } from 'react-bootstrap' import Space1 from '../../assets/images/space1.webp' import Space2 from '../../assets/images/space2.webp' import People from '../../assets/images/people.png' import Staff from '../../assets/images/staff.jpg' import '../../styles/Section6Style.css' const stories = [ { title: 'Our Space', text: ` Opened in 2014, our restaurant was born from a love of slow food and warm gatherings. Built with wood, stone, and fire at its heart, this space was designed for long meals, shared stories, and moments that linger. From the open kitchen to the soft light at night, every corner invites you to stay a little longer. `, images: [Space1, Space2] }, { title: 'Our People', text: ` Behind every dish is a small team that treats cooking as a craft. From our founders to our kitchen and floor staff, we work like a family — learning, sharing, and growing together. Passion over perfection, people over process. `, images: [People, Staff] } ] const RestaurantStory = () => { const [index, setIndex] = useState(0) const story = stories[index] return (

{story.title}

{story.text}

{stories.map((_, i) => ( ))}
) } export default RestaurantStory
